proposed_replacements.es: Esta misión tiene una intención interna de recomendación de productos. Normalmente no necesitas crear intenciones manuales para ella. Para otras tareas informativas respaldadas por fuentes autorizadas, consulta [Agente personalizado]({% link _journeys/custom-agent-playbook.md %}) y define intenciones dentro de su alcance. Las intenciones no habilitan recomendaciones de productos ni agregan herramientas.
proposed_replacements.en: This playbook has an internal product-recommendation intent. You usually do not need to create manual intents for it. For other informational tasks grounded in authorized sources, see [Custom Agent]({% link _journeys/custom-agent-playbook.md %}) and define intents within its scope. Intents do not enable product recommendations or add tools.

conclusion: Smart drift itself does not require broader prose changes or recapture. Apply the narrow Custom Agent clarification before marking this guide complete; Discount UI coverage belongs to the source/UI owner.
